A clinical state in which an individual is unresponsive to environmental stimuli.
Such individuals may also have breathing and circulatory problems. The cause
may be neurological, or may be due to other systemic diseases. An easy way of
finding the cause is to think in terms of the vowels:
· Apoplexy (stroke)
· Epilepsy
· Infections e.g. meningoencephalitis
· Overdosing with drugs, alcohol intoxication, toxins
· Uraemia and other metabolic disorders
· Other causes include: head injury; brain tumours (with complications)
